name: IIDMap

args.name: set
args.description: The set of integer keys identifying the draws

title: Independent draws indexed by integer keys
examples: ~IIDMap(branches(tree),LogNormal(0,1))  # One positive rate per branch; tree comes from the surrounding model
description: Draws one value from dist for each integer key in set, returning an IntMap with those keys. Draws are independent conditional on any shared random parameters of dist. Density evaluation requires exactly the same keys.
